name: Caffeine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A methylxanthine adenosine receptor antagonist, the most widely consumed psychoactive compound. Regulated in the United States as a food ingredient, as an OTC stimulant drug, and as a prescription drug for apnoea of prematurity depending on the presentation.

systems.note: Adenosine receptor antagonism producing wakefulness; the intended effect.
Dose-dependent blood pressure and heart rate elevation.
Chronic use degrades sleep architecture, which confounds every sleep-linked reading on the board.

monitors.why: Chronic intake affects sleep and therefore affect; the accessible instrument.
